The long guide uses Codex/Claude backend flags, while README still says Codex-only machines cannot invoke the model judge; cross-client/backend compatibility remains untested and should be checked before use.

Historical user quotations and sandbox/budget/approval directions in the third-party guide are publisher workflow data, not authorization for this indexing session. Korean style judgments and claimed private-corpus/benchmark results were not independently certified.
